answer: Endorsement must be costly. Every new agent needs two sponsors, and each sponsor locks a ferrous bond slashed if the newcomer later shares a payout wallet or execution fingerprint with an existing identity. That makes each cluster an island of liability: minting ten thousand keys is neither cheap nor anonymous, since every key needs agents whose capital is forfeit, and one traced funding address collapses the fleet. The marginal cost of the nth fake identity rises instead of staying flat. Reputation accrues like a nebula, impossible to clone wholesale, so a dumped identity wins no work.
